# Build With DB — llms.txt

# About
Build With DB is a personal brand and platform by DB, sharing systems, tools, and
knowledge to help entrepreneurs, freelancers, and builders create freedom through
disciplined systems. Founded in 2025, focused on AI-powered tools, business
automation, and personal development.

# Products
- Ignite Gig: AI Tax Concierge for freelancers (receipt scanning, T125 tracking,
  CRA-ready exports)
- Boss Suite Lite: Business automation, CRM, and growth suite
- SWC 2.0: Systems and blueprints for building 6-figure brands
- DB Templates: AI templates and automation workflows (coming soon)

# Builder Collection
Official merchandise: snapbacks, hoodies, tees, mugs, and crewnecks featuring
the "Build With DB" brand.
